hook: Your photo here shows the world's tallest statue.
title: India's Statue Is Taller Than Statue of Liberty
description:
The Statue of Unity in Gujarat stands 182 metres tall, the world's tallest statue and almost double the height of the Statue of Liberty. It honours Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who helped unite India's princely states. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #StatueOfUnity #India
